changelog:
Initial release of exam-rescue-html.

- Generates a printable three-section "exam rescue" checklist HTML: Core Formulas, High-Frequency Points, and Common Mistakes, based on knowledge_map.json.
- Fully automated, silent execution: no confirmation or process messages, all errors handled silently.
- Outputs HTML via template filling (assets/template.html), with dynamic sections omitted if empty.
- Includes rescue_notes.json write (for record), but only delivers the final HTML to users.
- Provides user-friendly guidance message upon completion, with options for regeneration or returning to mock questions.
